    @allure.feature("Logs")
    @allure.story("Session Trace Retention")
    @allure.title("Sessions older than 30 days show a retention message or no traces instead of empty detail")
    @allure.severity(allure.severity_level.NORMAL)
    @pytest.mark.logs
    def test_old_sessions_show_retention_message(logged_in_driver):
        """
        Bug: Sessions older than 30 days are listed in the Sessions tab, but clicking
        them shows an empty trace panel with no explanation — users have no way to know
        why there is no data.
        Expected: Old sessions should either be hidden/filtered, or display a clear
        message indicating that trace data is unavailable due to the 30-day retention policy.
    
        Steps:
        1. Navigate to Logs → Sessions.
        2. Find a session dated more than 30 days ago.
        3. Click the session.
        4. Assert that either a retention message is shown OR the session is not
           listed at all (filtered out).
        """
        driver = logged_in_driver
        cutoff = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=30)
    
        with allure.step("Navigate to Logs → Sessions tab"):
            logs_page = LogsPage(driver)
